notes: Native Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + NDK C++ DSP). Builds a debug APK — no web server, cannot appear in browser preview. Use 'docker compose -f docker-compose.base44.yml run --rm dsp-test' for the native DSP harness, 'run --rm build-apk' for the APK build, or add 'testDebugUnitTest' for JVM unit tests.
